# Postcards still needed

**22 still needed.** 20 of the route's 42 milestones already have a photo. Generated by `node scripts/postcard-manifest.mjs` — do not hand-edit.

## How to use this

1. Save each image into `public/postcards/` under the **exact filename** in the table.
2. Run `bash scripts/postcards.sh`. It checks every file is a real JPEG rather than a
   saved error page, and writes the `img:` line into `src/config.ts` for you.

A milestone with no photo is **not** broken — the celebration falls back to the brand
treatment. So these can land in any order, and partial progress ships fine.

## What makes a good one

- **Landscape, and wide.** They are full-bleed backdrops on the gym TV; anything
  portrait gets badly cropped.
- **Dark enough to read white text over.** The celebration puts the milestone name
  across the middle. A bright noon sky is the usual failure.
- **At least ~1600px wide**, and over 20 KB or the wizard will reject it.

## Licensing — this matters

These end up on 1080×1080 share cards that members post to Instagram, which is
commercial use of a gym brand. **Unsplash** and **Pexels** are free for that with no
attribution. **Wikimedia Commons** is fine too but the licence varies per image —
check each one. Do not pull from Google Images.
